definitions.explanation: The administrative and ritual duties involved in running a Shinto shrine. Includes managing ceremonies, maintaining shrine grounds, handling visitors, and conducting daily rituals.

examples.japanese: {社務|しゃむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧。
⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社務|しゃむ}{所|しょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Charms can be purchased at the shrine office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって{社務|しゃむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{携|たずさ}わり→携わる：09333_tazusawaru⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧きた。
examples.english: The head priest has been involved in shrine affairs for many years and has also put effort into managing the local festivals.

notes:
Refers to the various duties required to operate and maintain a Shinto shrine, encompassing both administrative tasks and religious ceremonies. Most commonly encountered by visitors in the compound ⟦{社務所|しゃむしょ}→社務所：22716_shamusho⟧ (shrine office), where visitors can purchase charms, receive blessings, and make inquiries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社務|しゃむ}{所|しょ}: shrine office (the most common use of this word)
- {社務|しゃむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}る: perform shrine duties
- {社務|しゃむ}⟦{日誌|にっし}→日誌：23512_nisshi⟧: shrine duty log

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{神事|しんじ}→神事：14066_shinji⟧: Shinto ritual or ceremony (focuses on the religious aspect)
- {寺務|じむ}: temple affairs (the Buddhist equivalent)
- {祭事|さいじ}: festival affairs; ceremonial duties
